messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The process is initiated by a switch-over request. In doing so, the customer transmits his data to the customer service department of the company. Customer service is a shared service center between the departments Sales and Distribution. The customer data is received by customer service and based on this data a customer data object is entered into the CRM system. After customer data has been entered it should then be compared with the internal customer data base and checked for completeness and plausibility. In case of any errors these should be corrected on the basis of a simple error list. The comparison of data is done to prevent individual customer data being stored multiple times. In case the customer does not exist in the customer data base, a new customer object is being created which will remain the data object of interest during the rest of the process flow. This object consists of data elements such as the customer's name and address and the assigned power gauge. The generated customer object is then used, in combination with other customer data to prepare the contract documents for the power supplier switch (including data such as bank connection, information on the selected rate, requested date of switch-over). In the following an automated check of the contract documents is carried out within the CIS (customer information system) in order to confirm their successful generation. In case of a negative response, i.e. the contract documents are not (or incorrectly) generated, the causing issues are being analyzed and resolved. Subsequently the contract documents are generated once again. In case of a positive response a confirmation document is sent out to the customer stating that the switch-over to the new supplier can be executed. A request to the grid operator is automatically sent out by the CIS. It puts the question whether the customer may be supplied by the selected supplier in the future. The switch-over request is checked by the grid operator for supplier concurrence, and the grid operator transmits a response comment. In the case of supplier concurrence the grid operator would inform all involved suppliers and demand the resolution of the conflict. The grid operator communicates with the old supplier and carries out the termination of the sales agreement between the customer and the old supplier (i.e. the customer service (of the new supplier) does not have to interact with the old supplier regarding termination). If there are not any objections by the grid operator (i.e. no supplier concurrence), customer service creates a CIS contract. The customer then has the chance to check the contract details and based on this check may decide to either withdraw from the switch contract or confirm it. Depending on the customer's acceptance / rejection the process flow at customer service either ends (in case of withdrawal) or continues (in case of a confirmation). An additional constraint is that the customer can only withdraw from the offered contract within 7 days after the 7th day the contract will be regarded as accepted and the process continues. The confirmation message by the customer is therefore not absolutely necessary (as it will count as accepted after 7 days in any way) but it can speed up the switch process. On the switch-date, but no later than 10 days after power supply has begun, the grid operator transmits the power meter data to the customer service and the old supplier via messages containing a services consumption report. At the same time, the grid operator computes the final billing based on the meter data and sends it to the old supplier. Likewise the old supplier creates and sends the final billing to the customer. For the customer as well as the grid operator the process ends then. After receiving the meter data customer service imports the meter data to systems that require the information. The process of winning a new customer ends here.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_1"
                  targetNamespace="http://bpmn.org/schema/bpmn"
                  exporter="Camunda Modeler"
                  exporterVersion="5.0.0">

  <!-- COLLABORATION -->
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CustomerService" name="Customer Service (Shared Service Center - Sales & Distribution)" processRef="Process_CustomerService" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_GridOperator" name="Grid Operator" processRef="Process_GridOperator" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OldSupplier" name="Old Supplier" processRef="Process_OldSupplier" />

    <!-- MESSAGE FLOWS -->
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_1" name="Switch-over Request" sourceRef="Task_Cust_SendRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_CS_Received" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_2" name="Confirmation Document" sourceRef="Task_CS_SendConfirmationDoc" targetRef="Event_Cust_ReceiveDoc" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_3" name="Switch-over Question" sourceRef="Task_CS_SendGridRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_GO_ReceiveRequest" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_4" name="Concurrence Conflict Notice" sourceRef="Task_GO_InformSuppliers" targetRef="Event_CS_ReceiveConcurrence" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_5" name="Response (No Objection)" sourceRef="Task_GO_SendResponse" targetRef="Event_CS_ReceiveGridResponse" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_6" name="Contract Withdrawal / Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_Cust_Decide" targetRef="Event_CS_ReceiveCustomerResponse" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_7" name="Meter Data (CS)" sourceRef="Task_GO_SendMeterData" targetRef="Event_CS_ReceiveMeterData" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_8" name="Meter Data & Final Billing (Old Supplier)" sourceRef="Task_GO_SendMeterData" targetRef="Event_OS_ReceiveMeterData" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_9" name="Final Billing" sourceRef="Task_OS_SendFinalBilling" targetRef="Event_Cust_ReceiveFinalBilling" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- PROCESS: CUSTOMER -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Cust" name="Desire Switch-over">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_C1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Cust_SendRequest" name="Transmit Data & Request Switch-over">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_C1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_C2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Cust_ReceiveDoc" name="Receive Confirmation Document">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_C2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_C3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_C1" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Cust_Decide" name="Check Contract Details & Decide (Confirm/Withdraw)">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_C3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_C4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Cust_ReceiveFinalBilling" name="Receive Final Billing from Old Supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_C4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_C5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_C2" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Cust" name="Customer Switch-over Completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_C5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Cust" targetRef="Task_Cust_SendRequest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_C2" sourceRef="Task_Cust_SendRequest" targetRef="Event_Cust_ReceiveDoc" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_C3" sourceRef="Event_Cust_ReceiveDoc" targetRef="Task_Cust_Decide" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_C4" sourceRef="Task_Cust_Decide" targetRef="Event_Cust_ReceiveFinalBilling" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_C5" sourceRef="Event_Cust_ReceiveFinalBilling" targetRef="EndEvent_Cust" />
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- PROCESS: CUSTOMER SERVICE -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CustomerService" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CS_Received" name="Switch-over Request Received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CS1" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CS_EnterCRM" name="Enter Customer Data into CRM">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:dataOutputAssociation id="DOA_1">
        <bpmn:targetRef>DataObjectReference_CustomerData</bpmn:targetRef>
      </bpmn:dataOutputAssociation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CS_CompareData" name="Compare with Internal Data Base & Check Completeness/Plausibility">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:dataInputAssociation id="DIA_1">
        <bpmn:sourceRef>DataObjectReference_CustomerData</bpmn:sourceRef>
      </bpmn:dataInputAssociation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorsExist" name="Errors Found?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Errors_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Errors_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CS_FixErrors" name="Correct Errors using Simple Error List">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Errors_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerExists" name="Customer Exists in DB?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Errors_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cust_No</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cust_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CS_CreateNewCustomer" name="Create New Customer Object">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cust_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:dataOutputAssociation id="DOA_2">
        <bpmn:targetRef>DataObjectReference_CustomerObject</bpmn:targetRef>
      </bpmn:dataOutputAssociation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeCustomerObj" name="Merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cust_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CS_PrepareContract" name="Prepare Contract Documents for Switch">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:dataInputAssociation id="DIA_2">
        <bpmn:sourceRef>DataObjectReference_CustomerObject</bpmn:sourceRef>
      </bpmn:dataInputAssociation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CS_AutomatedCheck" name="Automated Check of Documents in CIS">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS71</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CISResponse" name="CIS Generation Successful?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS71</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CIS_Negative</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CIS_Positive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CS_AnalyzeIssues" name="Analyze and Resolve Contract Generation Issues">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CIS_Negative</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_CS_SendConfirmationDoc" name="Send Confirmation Document to Customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CIS_Positive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_CS_SendGridRequest" name="Send Switch-over Request to Grid Operator via CIS">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_GridResponse" name="Wait for Grid Operator Response">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Catch_NoObjection</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Catch_Concurrence</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CS_ReceiveGridResponse" name="Response: No Objections">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Catch_NoObjection</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CS2" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CS_ReceiveConcurrence" name="Supplier Concurrence Conflict">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Catch_Concurrence</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CS3" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CS_ResolveConflict" name="Demand Conflict Resolution / Coordinate Resolution">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CS_ConflictTerminated" name="Process Terminated due to Unresolved Conflict">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CS_CreateCISContract" name="Create CIS Contract">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_CustomerResponse" name="Wait for Customer Acceptance / Withdrawal">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Catch_CustMsg</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Catch_Timer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CS_ReceiveCustomerResponse" name="Customer Message Received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Catch_CustMsg</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS15</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CS4" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CS_Timer7Days" name="7 Days Expiration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Catch_Timer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_1">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EvaluateCustDecision" name="Decision?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cust_Withdrawn</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cust_Confirmed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CS_Withdrawn" name="Process Ended (Customer Withdrawal)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cust_Withdrawn</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeAcceptance" name="Proceed with Switch">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cust_Confirmed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CS_ReceiveMeterData" name="Receive Meter Data (Services Consumption Report)">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS18</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CS5" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CS_ImportMeterData" name="Import Meter Data into Required Systems">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CS19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CS_Success" name="Process Ended (New Customer Won)">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CS19</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:dataObjectReference id="DataObjectReference_CustomerData" name="Customer Data" dataObjectRef="DataObject_CustomerData" />
    <bpmn:dataObject id="DataObject_CustomerData" />

    <bpmn:dataObjectReference id="DataObjectReference_CustomerObject" name="Customer Object [Name, Address, Power Gauge]" dataObjectRef="DataObject_CustomerObject" />
    <bpmn:dataObject id="DataObject_CustomerObject" />

    <!-- CS SEQUENCE FLOWS -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CS_Received" targetRef="Task_CS_EnterCRM" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS2" sourceRef="Task_CS_EnterCRM" targetRef="Task_CS_CompareData" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS3" sourceRef="Task_CS_CompareData" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorsExist" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Errors_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorsExist" targetRef="Task_CS_FixErrors" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Errors_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorsExist" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerExists" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS4" sourceRef="Task_CS_FixErrors" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerExists" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cust_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerExists" targetRef="Task_CS_CreateNewCustomer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cust_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerExists" targetRef="Gateway_MergeCustomerObj" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS5" sourceRef="Task_CS_CreateNewCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_MergeCustomerObj" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS6" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeCustomerObj" targetRef="Task_CS_PrepareContract" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS7" sourceRef="Task_CS_PrepareContract" targetRef="Task_CS_AutomatedCheck" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS71" sourceRef="Task_CS_AutomatedCheck" targetRef="Gateway_CISResponse" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CIS_Negative" name="Negative" sourceRef="Gateway_CISResponse" targetRef="Task_CS_AnalyzeIssues" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CIS_Positive" name="Positive" sourceRef="Gateway_CISResponse" targetRef="Task_CS_SendConfirmationDoc" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS8" sourceRef="Task_CS_AnalyzeIssues" targetRef="Task_CS_PrepareContract" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS9" sourceRef="Task_CS_SendConfirmationDoc" targetRef="Task_CS_SendGridRequest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS10" sourceRef="Task_CS_SendGridRequest" targetRef="Gateway_GridResponse" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Catch_NoObjection" sourceRef="Gateway_GridResponse" targetRef="Event_CS_ReceiveGridResponse" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Catch_Concurrence" sourceRef="Gateway_GridResponse" targetRef="Event_CS_ReceiveConcurrence" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS11" sourceRef="Event_CS_ReceiveGridResponse" targetRef="Task_CS_CreateCISContract" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS12" sourceRef="Event_CS_ReceiveConcurrence" targetRef="Task_CS_ResolveConflict" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS13" sourceRef="Task_CS_ResolveConflict" targetRef="EndEvent_CS_ConflictTerminated" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS14" sourceRef="Task_CS_CreateCISContract" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerResponse" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Catch_CustMsg" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerResponse" targetRef="Event_CS_ReceiveCustomerResponse" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Catch_Timer" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerResponse" targetRef="Event_CS_Timer7Days" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS15" sourceRef="Event_CS_ReceiveCustomerResponse" targetRef="Gateway_EvaluateCustDecision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cust_Withdrawn" name="Withdrawal" sourceRef="Gateway_EvaluateCustDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_CS_Withdrawn" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cust_Confirmed" name="Confirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_EvaluateCustDecision" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAcceptance" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS16" sourceRef="Event_CS_Timer7Days" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAcceptance" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS17" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAcceptance" targetRef="Event_CS_ReceiveMeterData" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS18" sourceRef="Event_CS_ReceiveMeterData" targetRef="Task_CS_ImportMeterData" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CS19" sourceRef="Task_CS_ImportMeterData" targetRef="EndEvent_CS_Success" />
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- PROCESS: GRID OPERATOR -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_GridOperator" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_GO_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive Switch-over Question">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_GO1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_GO1" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GO_CheckConcurrence" name="Check for Supplier Concurrence">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_GO1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_GO2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GO_Concurrence" name="Supplier Concurrence?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_GO2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GO_InformSuppliers" name="Inform All Involved Suppliers & Demand Conflict Resolution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_GO3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_GO_Conflict" name="Stopped Due to Conflict">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_GO3</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GO_SendResponse" name="Transmit Response (No Objections)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_GO4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GO_TerminateOldAgreement" name="Communicate with Old Supplier & Terminate Sales Agreement">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_GO4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_GO5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_GO_SwitchDate" name="On Switch-Date (Max 10 days post start)">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_GO5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_GO6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_2">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P10D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GO_SendMeterData" name="Transmit Power Meter Data (Consumption Report)">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_GO6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_GO7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GO_ComputeBilling" name="Compute Final Billing for Old Supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_GO7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_GO8</bpmn:outgoing>
